    haveI : NeZero n := k.neZero_of_exists
    k ≠ 0 → 1 ≤ k := by
  have : NeZero n := k.neZero_of_exists
  intro hk
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne n)
  cases n with

  | succ n =>

findings.evidence:
theorem Dense.continuous_upperBounds {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [Preorder α]
    [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ] {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S)
    (hf : Continuous f) :
    upperBounds (f '' S) = upperBounds (range f) := by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · -- `x` an upper bound of `f '' S` is an upper bound of `range f` by density
    intro x hx
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨i, rfl⟩
    have hi : f i ∈ closure (f '' S) := (hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS) ⟨i, rfl⟩
    -- `f i ≤ x` since `closure (f '' S) ⊆ Iic x`
    have : closure (f '' S) ⊆ Set.Iic x := by
      intro z hz
      rw [mem_closure_iff_frequently] at hz
      exact (hz.mono (by simpa [upperBounds, Set.mem_Iic] using hx)).mem_of_closed isClosed_Iic
    exact this hi
  · -- converse is monotonicity of upperBounds
    exact fun x hx => upperBounds_mono (Set.image_subset_range f S) le_rfl hx

theorem Dense.continuous_sup' {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [ClosedIicTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ]
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) :
    ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ s : S, f s := by
  classical
  rw [← sSup_range, ← sSup_range]
  obtain (_ | _) := isEmpty_or_nonempty γ
  · simp [Set.range_eq_empty]
  by_cases h1 : BddAbove (range f)
  · refine (isLUB_csSup (range_nonempty f) h1).unique ?_
    refine (isLUB_congr (hS.continuous_upperBounds hf)).mp (isLUB_ciSup_set ?_ hS.nonempty)
    exact h1.mono (Set.image_subset_range f S)
  · have h2 : ¬ BddAbove (range fun s : S => f (s : γ)) := by
      intro h2
      have h2' : BddAbove (f '' S) := by
        simpa [Set.image_eq_range] using h2
      have : BddAbove (range f) := by
        have hcl : BddAbove (closure (f '' S)) := h2'.closure
        refine hcl.mono (hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS)
      exact h1 (by simpa using this)
    simp [csSup_of_not_bddAbove h1, csSup_of_not_bddAbove h2]

findings.claim: `Dense.continuous_sup'`/`Dense.continuous_inf'` contain a fairly elaborate `simp_all`/`range_comp'` argument to transfer `¬ BddAbove`/`¬ BddBelow` to the restricted function; it can be shortened by expressing `range (fun s : S => f s)` as `f '' S` and using `hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense` plus `BddAbove.closure`/`BddBelow.closure`.
findings.suggested_fix: Refactor the `h2` subproof to: assume boundedness on `S`, take closures, and push along `hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS` to contradict `h1`; avoid `simp_all` and `range_comp'`.
findings.evidence:
theorem Dense.continuous_inf' {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    [ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [ClosedIciTopology α] {f : γ → α} [TopologicalSpace γ]
    {S : Set γ} (hS : Dense S) (hf : Continuous f) :
    ⨅ i, f i = ⨅ s : S, f s := by
  classical
  rw [← sInf_range, ← sInf_range]
  obtain (_ | _) := isEmpty_or_nonempty γ
  · simp [Set.range_eq_empty]
  by_cases h1 : BddBelow (range f)
  · refine (isGLB_csInf (range_nonempty f) h1).unique ?_
    refine (isGLB_congr (hS.continuous_lowerBounds hf)).mp (isGLB_ciInf_set ?_ hS.nonempty)
    exact h1.mono (Set.image_subset_range f S)
  · have h2 : ¬ BddBelow (range fun s : S => f (s : γ)) := by
      intro h2
      have h2' : BddBelow (f '' S) := by
        simpa [Set.image_eq_range] using h2
      have : BddBelow (range f) := by
        have hcl : BddBelow (closure (f '' S)) := h2'.closure
        refine hcl.mono (hf.range_subset_closure_image_dense hS)
      exact h1 (by simpa using this)
    simp [csInf_of_not_bddBelow h1, csInf_of_not_bddBelow h2]
